metadata.description: A collection of Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot and other skills-compatible agents, grouped into installable plugins.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug automated tests in whatever framework a repository already uses. Detects the stack at runtime rather than imposing a framework. With your agreement, it installs the project's own test runner when it is missing, and review-tests may run the project's documented setup — never anything else, and never unattended.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review code against Google's Standard of Code Review and the repository's own rules files and review checklist, reporting findings with Conventional Comments labels and CWE-named security categories. Also generates those rules files and the checklist the review reads.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Write architecture documentation, a product manual, or a document following your own template from repository source, verified dependency and call evidence, and reviewed prose — you choose the outline, none is mandatory — and check existing docs against a template. Produces multi-page docs with file:line citations and a human checkpoint for the final readings.

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: Design a change without touching code, or implement a feature, bug fix, or refactor and verify it against the original request — acceptance criteria fixed before coding, design patterns used only for a concrete problem, and evidence reported for every check.

plugins.name: verification
plugins.description: Set up a repository's own verification — its build, lint, static analysis, and test checks with pass/fail criteria, a feature map, and evidence capture — and verify any existing change against its goal, with evidence for every check and criterion and one honest verdict.
